name: Frans van Mieris the Elder

summary.text: Frans van Mieris the Elder, was a Dutch Golden Age genre and portrait painter. The leading member of a Leiden family of painters, his sons Jan (1660–1690) and Willem (1662–1747) and his grandson Frans van Mieris the Younger (1689–1763) were also accomplished genre painters.

14922848: Young Woman Stringing Pearls is a 1658 painting by the Dutch artist Frans van Mieris the Elder. It has been in the collection of the Musée Fabre, in Montpellier, France, since 1836.
17189254: Brothel Scene or Scene in an Inn is an oil on panel painting by the Dutch Golden Age painter Frans van Mieris, executed c. 1658–1659. Since 29 January 1960 it has been in the collection of the Mauritshuis, in The Hague.
20184860: Frans van Mieris the Elder, was a Dutch Golden Age genre and portrait painter. The leading member of a Leiden family of painters, his sons Jan (1660–1690) and Willem (1662–1747) and his grandson Frans van Mieris the Younger (1689–1763) were also accomplished genre painters.
30150849: A Cavalier is a 1657 oil on canvas self-portrait by the Dutch artist Frans van Mieris. In 2007 it was stolen from the Art Gallery of New South Wales and has not yet been recovered.
